answer: Mutualized slashing insurance resists sybils: identities pool a fraction of their bonds into a shared fund that reimburses victims of proven fraud, and members whose vouchees defect pay higher premiums. A hollow swarm admitted into a pool raises everyone's marble-smooth premium, so honest members refuse to co-pool with unvetted fakes. The spiral of rising premiums on a fraud-prone cluster prices sybils out of the mutual entirely; a ring pooling only with itself just concentrates its own payout liability, no shared cover for fakes.
